name: Super Sticky
summary: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants a fast profit and has a new idea: a super sticky glue. The tar for it must come from beasts in northern Un'Goro Crater, near the tar pits, and Tran'rek will share a little of the profit.

sections.title: A Sticky Idea
sections.body: Tran'rek hopes this newest idea will bring quick gold, and offers you a little of the profit. Ordinary tar is not sticky enough. Twelve samples are wanted, taken from creatures dwelling near the tar pits of northern Un'Goro Crater.

sections.title: Why the Beasts
sections.body: The plant-like creatures around the pits have chlorophyll in their skin. Mixed with the tar, it makes a super sticky glue.

sections.title: Once the Tar Arrives
sections.body: Tran'rek handles the tar and soon finds hands stuck together. The scheme changes on the spot: a super sticky tar remover, Tran'rek decides, is where the real money is.

faq.q: Who asks for the sticky tar?
Why does the tar have to come from beasts?
faq.answer: Regular tar is not sticky enough. The plant-like creatures around the tar pits have chlorophyll in their skin, which makes the tar super sticky.
By the tar pits of northern Un'Goro Crater.

faq.q: What does Tran'rek plan to do with the tar?
faq.answer: Tran'rek wants to make super sticky glue as a quick way to earn gold, and promises a little of the profit to whoever helps.
